findings.evidenceJa: 期限がないって訳じゃない
findings.governingReading: Rin specifically invokes a deadline as a reason to take initiative; it is not just the prediction that the conflict will eventually end somehow.
findings.explanation: A time limit is reduced to the war not lasting forever.

findings.evidenceJa: あの丘の光景が浮かんでしまう。
findings.governingReading: The scene occurs on the hill, not inside it.
findings.explanation: The remembered scene is placed in the hill.

findings.highlight: I do no see any need
findings.evidenceJa: 必要はないと思いますが
findings.governingReading: She says she does not think Rin needs to set time aside from investigation to teach Shirou.
findings.explanation: Saber’s objection has no instead of not.
